findings.title: Tile NLT default loses to an inherited main-header setting
findings.summary: A tile-wide nonlinear-transform override should win, but lookup returns the main header's component setting.
findings.scope: Parser-produced tile extensions; descriptor selection, not a full pixel decode.

findings.title: Valid PLM packet-length markers are rejected
findings.summary: The packet-length group count is one byte; the parser expects a four-byte count. A seven-byte legal marker fails.
findings.scope: Direct marker-parser test; distinguishes PLM from PPM's different framing.

findings.title: Valid reversible transforms have the wrong required coefficient count
findings.summary: The resolver demands N squared coefficients instead of N times (N+1), rejecting legal reversible decorrelation arrays.
findings.scope: Small, parser-produced integer arrays; admission failure, not a complete transform-correctness claim.

findings.title: Consistent PLM and PLT cannot be used together
findings.summary: Matching main-header and tile-header packet-length information works separately but is rejected when both are present.
findings.scope: Small tile-part fixtures; both descriptions are consistent.

findings.title: Inverse nonlinear LUT misses the full-scale endpoint
findings.summary: Normalization uses 2^precision instead of 2^precision-1. A descending LUT ends at sample 16 instead of 0.
findings.scope: Typed reconstruction stage with supplied decoded samples; not an entropy-decoder test.

findings.title: Selected-color context omits a registration-needed sample
findings.summary: Cropping uses unregistered component bounds and can omit the predecessor sample required by CRG registration.
findings.scope: Parsed geometry and validated selection; context coverage, not demonstrated rendered-color corruption.

findings.title: JPH component output incorrectly requires a color box
findings.summary: Unspecified-color JPH files with UnkC=1 are rejected unless colr is supplied, even when only component planes are requested.
findings.scope: Public decode_jph component output; does not require successful RGB conversion.

findings.title: A later color box that should be ignored causes rejection
findings.summary: After a valid first colr, an extra colr with a reserved method causes InvalidColorSpecification rather than being ignored.
findings.scope: JP2 header parsing; later ignored boxes, not the separate first-box unknown-method question.

findings.title: Color associations are mistaken for physical channel indices
findings.summary: One physical channel may describe RGB associations 1, 2 and 3; the validator rejects 2 and 3 because there is only one channel.
findings.scope: Metadata-parser record retention; not a complete color-rendering demonstration.

findings.title: An allowed second JP2 codestream rejects the file
findings.summary: JP2 may contain additional contiguous codestreams while displaying only the first; parsing rejects the second even below resource limits.
findings.scope: Public container parse; rejection prevents reaching later display behavior.

findings.title: The first inherited JPIP header lacks its standard defaults
findings.summary: A fresh response with omitted class/codestream should start at Class=0 and CSn=0; the parser returns InvalidJpipHeader.
findings.scope: Fresh header-parser context; opaque/empty body, not decoded packet semantics.

findings.title: An optional wire SOD marker is treated as mandatory
findings.summary: Automatic reconstruction rejects a complete empty or marker-only JPP tile-header bin when SOD is absent.
findings.scope: Smallest witness is complete empty tile0; direct normalization, not a complete image decode.

findings.title: Metadata fragments split into different bins when CSn changes
findings.summary: Metadata identity must ignore codestream number within one logical target. Complementary fragments instead remain in separate incomplete bins.
findings.scope: Typed identity/cache lookup; preserving raw wire CSn is allowed. Existing metadata candidates are not promoted.

findings.title: A clipped empty subband makes a valid precinct plan fail
findings.summary: Planning creates a zero-width code-block grid for an empty intersection, then packet construction rejects that grid.
findings.scope: Small header-only mapping fixture13; local SOT-bearing reconstruction convention, not raw JPP tile-header wire format.

findings.title: Empty reduced resolutions acquire phantom precincts
findings.summary: Equal reduced endpoints should yield zero precincts. A shifted 1x1 image produces four mappings instead of one.
findings.citation: T.800 (2019-06), B.6, equation (B-16); T.808 A.3.2.1 numbering
findings.scope: Fixture45 in the same replay as F14; separate geometry behavior, not a second independent test execution.
findings.extra_marker: fixture=45 progression=0 stream=62: A-1/B-16 mismatch; actual=4 expected=1

findings.title: Stream-equivalent contents keep the wrong box header
findings.summary: An xref replaced by equivalent colr contents is emitted with the original xref header/type instead of the equivalent header.
findings.scope: Four compact/extended header combinations; recursive metadata helper, not a complete JPX rendering.

findings.title: Reserved class identifiers get ordinary standard meanings
findings.summary: Class 3 becomes TileHeader and class 7 becomes MainHeader although neither meaning is assigned by the cited edition.
findings.scope: No separately negotiated extension. Does not impose a universal reject-unknown rule on raw-header tools.

findings.title: Single-stream placeholders reject a permitted count field
findings.summary: For flags 01xx, a present NCS must be treated as 1 regardless of its value. The parser leaves it unread and rejects the extra bytes.
findings.scope: Complete small placeholder payload; even optional NCS=1 fails. No large stream enumeration.

findings.title: An invalid nonzero tile-part length becomes an unknown length
findings.summary: A declared Psot shorter than the retained header underflows subtraction and becomes None, the sentinel reserved for Psot=0.
findings.scope: Direct local SOT-bearing transition parser. Acceptance/sentinel confusion is established; the exact error category is inferred.

findings.title: Ordinary COC accepts forbidden zero precinct exponents
findings.summary: PPx or PPy is accepted as zero above the lowest resolution level, although the Part 1 parameter table forbids it there.
findings.scope: Ordinary Part 1, Rsiz=0; does not generalize to unresolved Part 2 directional cases.

findings.title: An Association box accepts too few children
findings.summary: The metadata inspector accepts an empty or single-child asoc even though an Association requires at least two immediate children.
findings.scope: Structural metadata-inspection contract; smallest input is an eight-byte empty box.

findings.title: Mixed layer-registration presence is accepted
findings.summary: Once one compositing layer has creg, every layer must have it. Validation accepts a two-layer file with only one registered layer.
findings.scope: Parser-produced layers passed to the dedicated reference validator.

findings.title: Palette entry counts above 1024 are admitted
findings.summary: The palette parser accepts NE=1025 and larger values instead of enforcing the cited 1..1024 range.
findings.scope: Smallest negative case is a 1037-byte box; this is a palette-validation gap.

findings.title: JPX codestream headers can be missing after some are supplied
findings.summary: If a JPX file supplies any codestream-header boxes, it must supply one per codestream. Two streams with only one header are accepted.
findings.scope: Container-validation guarantee; not a claim that every permissive reader must reject every invalid file.

findings.title: Extra signature and File Type boxes escape uniqueness validation
findings.summary: After valid initial boxes, duplicate top-level signature/ftyp boxes are accepted as extra metadata despite the exactly-one constraints.
findings.scope: Two backing cases. File-structure/validation mismatch, not a universal reader-MUST-reject claim.

findings.title: Explicit-plan output ignores its effective-tile LRCP restriction
findings.summary: The final validator checks main-header progression only; transcode publishes four non-LRCP tile overrides outside its documented profile.
findings.scope: Project profile, not a claim that JPEG 2000 universally prohibits non-LRCP. No pixel corruption is established.

findings.title: Reduced decoding applies the wrong tile's nonlinear transform
findings.summary: Full-resolution tile bounds are compared with reduced output coordinates. A selected native sample is 128 where the tile transform requires 64.
findings.citation: Project README.md, lines 81-83 (native-resolution selection); tile-local NLT semantics
findings.scope: Public selected-decoder reproduction at discard=1. Originally inferred clause; the concrete coordinate/sample mismatch has separate source/fixture support.
